company.name: AutoStream
company.tagline: Automated video editing tools for content creators
company.description: AutoStream is a SaaS platform that empowers content creators with AI-powered video editing, automated captions, and smart rendering at any resolution.

plans.name: Basic Plan
plans.ideal_for: Hobbyists and beginners starting their content journey

plans.name: Pro Plan
plans.ideal_for: Professional creators, agencies, and serious YouTubers/Instagrammers

refund_policy.description: No refunds are issued after 7 days from the date of purchase.
refund_policy.details: Customers may request a full refund within the first 7 days of their subscription. After the 7-day window, no refunds will be processed. Cancellations stop future billing but do not trigger refunds.

support_policy.basic_plan: Email support available Monday through Friday during business hours.
support_policy.pro_plan: 24/7 priority support via live chat, email, and phone.

policies.cancellation: You may cancel your subscription at any time. Access continues until the end of the billing period.
policies.data_privacy: All uploaded videos are encrypted and stored securely. AutoStream does not use your content for AI training without explicit consent.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade from Basic to Pro mid-cycle?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can upgrade at any time. The price difference is prorated for the remaining billing period.

faqs.question: What platforms does AutoStream work with?
faqs.answer: AutoStream is web-based and works on all modern browsers. It integrates directly with YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Vimeo for one-click publishing.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer a 7-day free trial on the Pro plan with no credit card required.

faqs.question: What video formats are supported for upload?
faqs.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, and WebM uploads up to 10GB per file.

faqs.question: Does the AI captioning support multiple languages?
faqs.answer: Yes, AI captions on the Pro plan support over 50 languages with high accuracy.
